title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 18
paragraphs: He kept up this war for eleven years, in the course of which the Milesians suffered two great defeats — once when they fought a battle in their own territory in the district of Limeneium, and again on the plain of the Maeander. For six of those eleven years, Sadyattes the son of Ardys was still ruler of the Lydians and was the one who kept invading Milesian territory at those seasons, for he was the one who had first begun the war. But for the last five of the eleven years, the war was carried on by Alyattes, the son of Sadyattes, who inherited it from his father (as I have already said) and took it up in earnest. None of the Ionians helped the Milesians bear the burden of this war except the people of Chios. They came to their aid to repay them in kind, for the Milesians had earlier helped the Chians all the way through their war against the people of Erythrae.
